title: Conditional κ = 0.003646221436446 (+5.51507748e-7 over #7277): funded helper 863 return
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Propose conditional **κ = 0.003646221436446**, a gain of **0.000000551507748** over exact #7277 under the same signed 17-stage caller and five framework assumptions.

Public helper 863 now returns on rank-four chart 240. The word drops its rank-five lift and four subsequent reads. Sixteen timed corrections replace those reads, using two chart-local caches and a billed split of role 1355's rank-six route into rank one and rank five. Per native call, `ΔT = {4:+1, 9:−1}` and `ΔP = {1:+1, 6:−1}`. Both rank masses fall by five. The entire signed invoice has **22,461 productive positions, 110,536 paid positions, rank surplus 1,424 and no empty-root credit**.

The directed raw crossing is in `(0.0036462214364462343366888845568980, 0.0036462214364462343366888845568981)`. Both engines reject the #7277 invoice at the new claim. The fixed-profile ambient-145 remainder relaxation crosses in `[0.00580905464175, 0.00580905464222]` (about `0.002162833206` of relaxed headroom, 62.77% realized). This ceiling applies only to that packing model.

## Task and overlap

Card `p104-side-correction`, priority revision 8, on canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. Exact parent #7277 `ed090b57ed88f8859e5ff4643645099e6ba856ea`; exact caller #7113 `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`. The scope changes to the timed public return of helper 863 and the paid donor route of role 1355. #7274 is the funded-return precedent on a different helper; #7277 fixes scalar chronology, #7308 studies existing owned MOVEs and #7311 studies adjacent owned exchanges. [Discussion finding](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19550590).

Only `research/p104-funded-863-return/` is new scientific work. The branch retains the two exact, already-published #7257 navigation and historical replay prerequisites. It makes no change to the selected record.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-funded-863-return
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-funded-863-return --check-modes --check-source-history
```

Local source-aware verification on CPython 3.12, Linux x86-64: complete literal source and candidate reconstruction; arbitrary-input forward and adjoint including the actual COPY guard; both pure cache captures and paid split; all 3,037 physical catalogue maps, 104 main boundaries, all 54 strict and four functional outer predicates; exact price, fresh grid, ownership, ordinary work **782,663,376 < 10⁹**, precision coefficient **2,430** and fixed tape substitution. Controls reject a missing donor correction, malformed ownership, insufficient grid, dirty COPY and insufficient BIT. The two stationary caches are billed: 72 lifetimes, peak 50, 68 labels and unchanged owned ascent mass 56. See the frozen receipts and `REPLAY.txt`. Hosted checks are reported separately on this PR.
